name: io.github.Jayzilva/helionyx
title: Helionyx
description: Size hybrid solar PV, wind, battery, diesel and grid systems: hourly simulation, NPC ranking.

environmentVariables.name: HNX_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Workspace directory for the database, artefacts and exports (default ~/.helionyx)

environmentVariables.name: HNX_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to use only cached and bundled data (no network calls)

environmentVariables.name: HNX_REOPT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional NREL REopt API key for the reopt cross-check solver
